title: Promotion Exam: Total Fu for the Hand
description: A promotion exam where you add up the fu of a whole riichi mahjong hand and answer the total after rounding up. You can make at most one mistake
prompt: Answer the total fu for this hand

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get questions like this. Add up the base fu, the fu for how you won, the fu for the sets, the pair and the wait, then answer the total rounded up to the next 10 fu.
